Container.Name: drocsid
Container.Overview: drocsid flips movie night right-side up. Stream movies, shows and live TV from your Plex, Jellyfin or Emby server into a Discord voice channel, synced to the frame for the whole crew. Friends browse and hit play from a web portal without ever touching your media server, and you run it all from a self-hosted admin panel. Setup: see the Project page.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Port on your server for the web portal and setup wizard (default 3005). Point your reverse proxy (e.g. Nginx Proxy Manager) at this port for the public https address.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User drocsid runs as and owns its App data folder with (99 = nobody on Unraid)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group for the same (100 = users on Unraid)

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Settings, play history, lineup and watch progress
